text: Long night here. I foster a 7 year old boy and he will not settle to sleep tonight, keeps getting up, coming in, going back, coming in again. Otherwise he's honestly fine, eating, playing, chatting away. His temp is 37.9. The main thing is his eye, it's gone pink and sticky, gunk in the corner, I've been wiping it with cotton wool and warm water. I also want to mention he has red spots on his legs and arms but before anyone panics, we were out in the garden all day yesterday and the mozzies were awful, I got bitten too. They're the usual raised itchy bite bumps, just where he had shorts and t-shirt on, nowhere else. I did check his neck because I always worry, and he can look right down at his toes fine. No fits or shaking or jerky movements or anything like that either. I just want to know if the eye needs seeing tomorrow and if there's anything to help him settle because I'm running on empty.
